tool_schemas.name: resolve-library-id
tool_schemas.description: Searches the Context7 catalog for the provided free-text libraryName and returns a list of matching Context7-compatible library IDs (for example, "/org/project" and, when known, versioned variants); results are returned as a simple match list (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if libraryName is missing or not a string, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed allowed request throughput.

libraryName.description: Library name to search for and retrieve a Context7-compatible library ID.

tool_schemas.name: get-library-docs
tool_schemas.description: Returns a token-limited documentation extract for the specified context7CompatibleLibraryID, optionally focused by topic, assembled from the library’s indexed documentation chunks; the response is truncated to the requested tokens (or the default) and is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if context7CompatibleLibraryID is missing/invalid or tokens is not a number, NOT_FOUND if the library ID does not exist in Context7 or has no available docs, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed allowed request throughput.

context7CompatibleLibraryID.description: Exact Context7-compatible library ID (e.g., '/mongodb/docs', '/vercel/next.js', '/supabase/supabase', '/vercel/next.js/v14.3.0-canary.87') retrieved from 'resolve-library-id' or directly from user query in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version'.

tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens of documentation to retrieve (default: 10000). Higher values provide more context but consume more tokens.

tool_schemas.name: list-libraries
tool_schemas.description: Lists libraries in the Context7 catalog with optional filtering; results are paged. Returns only libraries matching the requested status filters. Refuses invalid pagination or filter values with VALIDATION_ERROR and may return RATE_LIMITED when throughput limits are exceeded.

query.description: Optional free-text filter applied to libraries.display_name and keywords (case-insensitive).

status.description: Filter by library status; use 'any' to include all statuses (default: active).

org.description: Filter by exact org segment of the canonical library ID (e.g., 'vercel').

project.description: Filter by exact project segment of the canonical library ID (e.g., 'next.js').

keyword.description: Filter to libraries whose keywords include this value (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of libraries to return per page (default: 50).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

sort.description: Sort order for results (default: relevance when query is provided, otherwise updated_at_desc).

tool_schemas.name: get-library
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single library by its canonical Context7-compatible library ID (for example, '/org/project'). Returns the library record. Raises NOT_FOUND if no library exists for the given ID and VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs.

libraryID.description: Canonical Context7-compatible library ID in the form '/org/project'.

include.description: Optional related entities to include in the response when available.

tool_schemas.name: upsert-library-alias
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new alias for a library or updates an existing alias by id. Returns the created/updated alias. Refuses aliases that reference a non-existent library, invalid alias_type/source values, or invalid lifecycle transitions with VALIDATION_ERROR.

id.description: Alias id to update; omit to create a new alias.

library_id.description: Target library id (canonical '/org/project') for this alias.

alias_text.description: Alias text used for resolution (stored and matched normalized to lower/trim).

alias_type.description: Type of alias to help ranking and diagnostics.

popularity_score.description: Non-negative score used for ranking matches among aliases.

status.description: Alias lifecycle status; transitions must follow the alias lifecycle rules.

tool_schemas.name: upsert-library-version
tool_schemas.description: Creates a library version or updates an existing version by id, including managing the per-library default version atomically. Returns the created/updated version. Refuses versions that do not belong to the specified library, duplicate defaults, or invalid lifecycle transitions with VALIDATION_ERROR.

id.description: Version id to update; omit to create a new version.

context7_compatible_library_id.description: Versioned Context7-compatible library ID in the form '/org/project/version'.

is_default.description: When true, makes this version the library default and atomically unsets any previous default.

status.description: Version lifecycle status; transitions must follow the version lifecycle rules.

tool_schemas.name: upsert-doc-source
tool_schemas.description: Creates a documentation source or updates an existing source by id, including starting/stopping ingestion via ingest_status transitions. Returns the created/updated doc source. Refuses sources whose library_version_id does not belong to the same library_id, invalid ingest_status transitions, or invalid URLs with VALIDATION_ERROR.

id.description: Doc source id to update; omit to create a new doc source.

library_version_id.description: Optional library version id this source belongs to; must reference a version for the same library_id when set.

source_type.description: Type of documentation source used for ingestion and parsing.

base_url.description: Base URL or locator for the source (e.g., 'https://nextjs.org/docs').

ingest_status.description: Ingestion lifecycle state; setting values triggers the corresponding transition when allowed (e.g., 'pending' to enqueue, 'disabled' to stop serving and/or prevent ingestion).

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit status for the presented credential. Refuses missing/invalid credentials with UNAUTHORIZED.

apiKey.description: Context7 API key to authenticate the caller (sent as a parameter when headers are not available).

metadata.name: Context7
